page.layout: One printed page: title page. Centred block of title lines in the middle of the page: "TOMO QUINTO" in spaced capitals, "CONTINENTUR" in italic small capitals, then a list of lines with a large initial C at the left of the first line. Below the list, an engraving (not text). Faint show-through of the reverse page's title (mirrored) at top and in the middle, and faint printer's imprint at the bottom, which is not transcribed as it is faint show-through.
page.notes: The large initial C of "Commentarius" is set as a decorative capital joined to the first line; it is transcribed as "COmmentarius" with the initial. The faint mirrored text at the top (OPERUM / JOHANNIS COCCEI / DUM VIVERET / IN ACADEMIA LUGDUNO-BATAVA / SS. THEOLOGIAE PROFESSORIS) and the faint imprint at the foot (Lugd. Batav. ... Ex Officina Johannis à Sommeren, Anno MDCLXXIII) are show-through or very faint and are not transcribed as page text. No page number printed.
